{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDHpYDHF7HVXhcaDvXAC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GhEEhFpwXxamTREZ1TFYz2","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUM_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\nID_COL = \"patient_id\"\n\n\ndef iqr_mask(s: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile([0.25, 0.75])\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (s < q1 - k * iqr) | (s > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]\n    for c in NUM_COLS:\n        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors=\"coerce\")\n\n    outlier_ids = set()\n\n    # 1. Technical noise: values impossible in reality\n    noise = (\n        df[\"avg_glucose_level\"].isna() | ~df[\"avg_glucose_level\"].between(20, 800)\n        | df[\"bmi\"].isna() | ~df[\"bmi\"].between(10, 60)\n        | df[\"age\"].isna() | (df[\"age\"] > 120) | (df[\"age\"] < 0)\n    )\n    outlier_ids |= set(df.loc[noise, ID_COL])\n    d = df.loc[~noise].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 2. Extreme outliers via 3*IQR\n    iqr_out = pd.Series(False, index=d.index)\n    for c in [\"age\", \"bmi\"]:\n        iqr_out |= iqr_mask(d[c])\n\n    glu = iqr_mask(d[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n    if glu.any():\n        stroke_rate = d.loc[glu, \"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_rate >= 0.5:\n            glu[:] = False\n        elif stroke_rate > 0.2:\n            glu = iqr_mask(np.log2(d[\"avg_glucose_level\"]))\n            if glu.any() and d.loc[glu, \"stroke\"].mean() >= 0.5:\n                glu[:] = False\n    iqr_out |= glu\n\n    outlier_ids |= set(d.loc[iqr_out, ID_COL])\n    d = d.loc[~iqr_out].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 3. Risk proxy: product of max-normalized numerical features\n    d[\"risk_proxy\"] = np.prod([d[c] / d[c].max() for c in NUM_COLS], axis=0)\n\n    # 4. Multivariate outliers via squared Mahalanobis distance\n    feats = NUM_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]\n    X = d[feats].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.pinv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(1 - 0.01, df=len(feats))\n    maha_out = d2 > crit\n    outlier_ids |= set(d.loc[maha_out, ID_COL])\n    d = d.loc[~maha_out].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations\n    smoking = d[\"smoking_status\"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()\n    work = d[\"work_type\"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()\n    cat_out = (\n        ((d[\"age\"] <= 14) & smoking.isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"]))\n        | ((work == \"children\") & (d[\"age\"] > 14))\n        | ((d[\"age\"] <= 3) & (work == \"student\"))\n    )\n    outlier_ids |= set(d.loc[cat_out, ID_COL])\n\n    # Map back to original row indices via the unique patient_id\n    return df.index[df[ID_COL].isin(outlier_ids)].astype(int).tolist()\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":820,"cache_read_input_tokens":30230,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":820,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ce82653f-d83d-4454-bb63-24de3e2cb378","uuid":"91f432e3-03f7-454f-9df2-1db00ff4d27c","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:57:56.642Z"}
